online grocery.Online Orders Agent: Places, changes and cancels online grocery orders and delivery slots.
online grocery.Missing & Substituted Items Agent: Handles items missing from a delivery, wrong substitutions and damaged goods, with refunds for them.
online grocery.Loyalty Card Agent: Handles loyalty card points, vouchers and linking a card to an account.
online grocery.Click & Collect Agent: Handles collecting online orders from a store: collection times, lockers and collection problems.
online grocery.Store Feedback Agent: Takes feedback and complaints about physical stores, staff and opening hours.

smartwatch maker.Device Setup Agent: Helps set up a new watch: pairing with a phone, first start and language.
smartwatch maker.Sync & App Agent: Fixes the companion app: data not syncing, notifications and app crashes.
smartwatch maker.Battery & Hardware Agent: Handles battery drain, charging problems, cracked screens and broken straps.
smartwatch maker.Health Features Agent: Explains heart-rate, sleep, step and workout tracking.
smartwatch maker.Returns Agent: Handles returning a watch within the return period and refunds for returns.

council waste services.Bin Collections Agent: Handles regular household bin collection days and missed collections.
council waste services.Bulky Waste Agent: Books collection of large items such as sofas, fridges and mattresses.
council waste services.Recycling Agent: Explains what goes in which recycling bin and orders new recycling boxes.
council waste services.Garden Waste Agent: Handles the paid garden waste subscription and its collections.
council waste services.Fly-Tipping Agent: Takes reports of rubbish dumped illegally in public places.

online marketplace for sellers.Seller Payouts Agent: Handles when and how sellers are paid for their sales.
online marketplace for sellers.Listings Agent: Helps create and edit product listings, photos and prices.
online marketplace for sellers.Disputes Agent: Handles buyer complaints, returns opened by buyers and item-not-received claims.
online marketplace for sellers.Shipping Labels Agent: Creates postage labels and fixes label and courier pickup problems.
online marketplace for sellers.Account Verification Agent: Verifies seller identity and business documents and lifts account holds.

home appliance maker.Engineer Visits Agent: Books an engineer to repair a broken appliance at home.
home appliance maker.Spare Parts Agent: Sells replacement parts such as filters, shelves, seals and hoses.
home appliance maker.Warranty Registration Agent: Registers new appliances and extends warranties.
home appliance maker.Product Manuals Agent: Explains how to use appliance settings and programmes, and sends manuals.
home appliance maker.Safety Recalls Agent: Handles safety recalls and checks whether a model is affected.

cinema chain.Ticket Booking Agent: Books cinema tickets and seats, and handles booking errors.
cinema chain.Refunds & Exchanges Agent: Refunds or exchanges tickets for cancelled or missed showings.
cinema chain.Cinema Membership Agent: Handles the monthly cinema membership: joining, cancelling and member benefits.
cinema chain.Cinema Accessibility Agent: Arranges wheelchair spaces, subtitled and audio-described screenings and carer tickets.
cinema chain.Food & Drink Agent: Handles snack orders, pre-ordered food and food allergen information.

bike share scheme.Rider Account Agent: Handles sign-up, login, payment cards and ride history.
bike share scheme.Bike Faults Agent: Takes reports of broken bikes: brakes, flat tyres, gears and lights.
bike share scheme.Docking Stations Agent: Handles full or empty docks and bikes that will not lock or release.
bike share scheme.Ride Charges Agent: Explains ride prices and fixes wrong or extra charges.
bike share scheme.Passes & Plans Agent: Sells and manages day passes, annual passes and student plans.

accounting software.Invoicing Agent: Helps create, send and chase invoices and quotes.
accounting software.Payroll Agent: Helps run payroll, payslips and employee pay settings.
accounting software.Bank Feeds Agent: Connects bank accounts and fixes transactions that do not import.
accounting software.Tax Returns Agent: Helps prepare and file VAT and tax returns from the software.
accounting software.Users & Login Agent: Manages user logins, passwords and permissions for the team.

hair salon chain.Salon Bookings Agent: Books, moves and cancels hair appointments.
hair salon chain.Prices & Services Agent: Explains treatments, prices and how long services take.
hair salon chain.Complaints Agent: Handles complaints about a cut, colour or treatment and arranges fixes.
hair salon chain.Gift Vouchers Agent: Sells gift vouchers and checks voucher balances.
hair salon chain.Hair Products Agent: Advises on and sells shampoos, conditioners and styling products.

charity.Donations Agent: Handles one-off and monthly donations, changing or stopping them, and tax relief on donations.
charity.Fundraising Events Agent: Handles sign-ups and questions for runs, walks and sponsored events.
charity.Volunteering Agent: Matches people to volunteering roles and handles volunteer questions.
charity.Charity Shops Agent: Handles donating goods to charity shops and shop opening times.
charity.Data & Privacy Agent: Handles mailing preferences, unsubscribing and personal data requests.
